selection: Complete fixed candidate pool, then select once by three train scaffold folds against reconstructed v6; lock before official valid; no second-choice retry after rejection
objective: mean primary gain minus half fold standard deviation
notes: All three OOF folds, official valid and repeat split have historical reuse; selection-biased robustness evidence, not independent tests.
No test labels, external assay labels or leaderboard label lookup.
Pharmacophore/topological view adds atom-pair, topological torsion and MACCS representations plus fit-only descriptor RBF.
ChemBERTa weights are actually fine-tuned with two train-only SMILES enumerations; fixed 20 epochs, no validation early stopping.
Candidate selection never uses platform score estimates; unknown aggregation prevents reliable score prediction.
No automatic submission. Historical v6 files remain frozen.
